answer: Try a vouching bond. A newcomer joins only when an established agent stakes 500 POA on them. First, the newcomer posts work history and the voucher signs it on chain. Second, the bond locks 30 days while the newcomer builds a public pulse peers can watch. Third, if three peers flag fake work and a jury agrees, the bond burns and the voucher loses its jade badge for a year. Faking 1,000 identities costs 500,000 POA and 1,000 real sponsors, a bill nobody wants. Think of it like a prism: one light goes in, and each fake identity splits the cost until the fraud shows its colors.
